title: Broker information | EC Assets
description: Statutory information about EC Assets as an insurance broker.

blocks.html: This is a structural placeholder for the mockup. The final wording must come from EC Assets' legal counsel before publication.
Information about EC Assets in its role as an insurance broker, as required by German law.
Licensed as an insurance broker under § 34d (1) of the German Trade Regulation Act. Registration number D-1234-ABCDE-56.
The registration can be checked in the public register of insurance intermediaries maintained by the German Chamber of Industry and Commerce.
EC Assets holds no direct or indirect share of more than 10 percent in any insurer, and no insurer holds such a share in EC Assets.
EC Assets receives commission from the insurers whose products it brokers. No separate fee is charged to the customer for brokerage.
Complaints can be sent to legal@ecassets.com or to the insurance ombudsman, Versicherungsombudsmann e. V., Postfach 08 06 32, 10006 Berlin.
